name: Binder/granulating-fluid preparation and wet granulation endpoint
purpose: Prepare the binder solution/granulating liquid and run high-shear or fluid-bed granulation to a defined endpoint.
config_options: binder preparation sub-steps (solvent quantity, dissolution time, temperature, visual clarity check) and its hold time
granulator class (high-shear, fluid-bed)
parameters: impeller/chopper speeds, liquid addition rate and total, spray rate/atomisation pressure (fluid-bed), inlet air temperature/volume
endpoint criterion: time, power consumption/torque, total liquid, or combination
wet massing time
engine_enforced_rules: binder solution must be used within its validated hold time
liquid quantity added is captured from the load cell/flow meter and compared to the approved range
endpoint parameter trace and the endpoint value are recorded from the equipment where interfaced; manual endpoint calls require a reason and verification
any parameter outside its proven acceptable range raises an exception

name: Drying with LOD endpoint loop
purpose: Dry wet granules (fluid-bed or tray) and sample for loss on drying until the moisture endpoint is met.
config_options: dryer class and drying parameters (inlet/outlet/product temperature, airflow, time)
LOD method (moisture analyser, instrument ID class), sample size
LOD limits (upper and, if needed, lower)
maximum drying iterations and total drying time
sampling location(s)
engine_enforced_rules: each LOD iteration is kept with time, sample, instrument and result; later iterations cannot overwrite earlier ones
exit only when the endpoint criterion is met; exceeding the maximum iterations or time raises an exception
over-drying below a lower limit (if configured) is an exception, not silently accepted
moisture analyser calibration/performance check status verified before use

name: Dry granulation (roller compaction / slugging)
purpose: Record and control roller compaction or slugging, including ribbon/slug checks, and subsequent size reduction.
config_options: roll pressure/force, roll gap, roll speed, feed screw speed, vacuum deaeration
ribbon checks: thickness, density/solid fraction, frequency
integrated mill screen size and speed
recycle of fines allowed or not and its limit
engine_enforced_rules: parameters captured from the compactor where interfaced; excursions outside approved ranges create exceptions
periodic ribbon checks are scheduled and missed checks are flagged
recycled fines quantity (if allowed) is recorded and kept within the approved limit

name: Milling/sieving with screen integrity check
purpose: Size-reduce or screen material and prove the screen/sieve was intact before and after use (to exclude metal/mesh contamination).
config_options: mill/sieve class and screen size/type ID
mill speed and feed rate
screen integrity check at start and end (visual, photo)
action on damaged screen (quarantine of material processed since last good check)
engine_enforced_rules: the specific screen ID is scanned and must be of the approved size/type
pre-use and post-use integrity checks are mandatory; a failed post-use check raises an exception and holds the material processed
screen use is logged against the screen's own logbook

name: Blending/lubrication and blend uniformity sampling
purpose: Blend (and lubricate) to the approved endpoint and, where required, sample for blend uniformity (thief sampling or in-line NIR/PAT).
config_options: blender class, fill level range, rotation speed, blending time or number of revolutions, lubrication time
order of addition
blend uniformity plan: number and positions of sampling locations, sample size (1-3x unit dose), replicate samples
PAT option: NIR model reference, endpoint criterion, data import
engine_enforced_rules: blending time/revolutions are measured from equipment or timer, not typed; minimum and maximum enforced
over-lubrication (exceeding maximum lubrication time) raises an exception
blend samples get unique IDs by location and are linked to LIMS; missing locations are flagged
PAT results are stored with model version and status; a model-predicted endpoint does not waive physical sampling unless the approved control strategy says so
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110(a)(3) (adequacy of mixing), 211.160; FDA draft guidance on 211.110 (Jan 2025) on process models; FDA's 2003 stratified-sampling draft guidance was withdrawn in 2013

name: Compression set-up with tooling
purpose: Set up the rotary press for a product: bind the press and the punch/die set, verify tooling identity/condition, load approved machine settings and approve first tablets.
config_options: press class and number of stations; single-sided or double-sided (left/right) output
tooling set requirements (shape, dimensions, embossing/debossing, tip type, multi-tip)
tooling checks: set ID scan, visual inspection, punch length measurement tolerance, cumulative compression count vs tooling life limit
machine settings template (turret speed, pre-/main compression force, fill depth, feeder speed) with approved ranges
first-off/start-up checks and number of start-up rejects to discard
engine_enforced_rules: tooling set must match the product's approved tooling specification; wrong embossing/shape blocks start
tooling past its usage/inspection limit or with a failed inspection cannot be bound
settings outside approved ranges require an exception; changes during the run are captured with time and user
first-off tablets must pass the configured start-up IPC before routine compression is released
tooling usage counter is updated from press counts at the end of the run

name: Periodic compression IPC scheduler (multi-station / left-right)
purpose: Schedule and enforce in-process checks during compression at defined intervals, separately per press side/output and for events (start, restart, parameter change, end).
config_options: interval by time (e.g. every 30 min) or by count of tablets/turret revolutions
separate sampling streams per side (left/right) or per layer/output
event triggers: start-up, after stoppage > X min, after setting change, end of run, container change
tests per check (weight, breaking force, thickness, appearance, friability, disintegration) with different frequencies
grace window before a check is overdue
engine_enforced_rules: an overdue check raises an alert, then an exception; tablets produced after a missed check are flagged for evaluation
a failing check puts the output since the last passing check on hold (container-level traceability via container IDs)
samples and results are tied to side/station stream and to the time window they represent
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110(a)(1)-(2) (weight variation, disintegration), 211.110(b); EU GMP Chapter 5

name: Tablet weight uniformity IPC with statistics
purpose: Weigh n individual tablets (and/or group weights of 10/20) per check and evaluate against absolute and mean-relative limits.
config_options: n tablets per check; individual and/or group weighing
target mass and limits: mean limits, individual limits absolute or as % deviation from mean in two tiers
statistics: mean, SD, RSD, min, max, count outside tier 1/tier 2
balance interface and auto-print ticket import
control-chart display (mean and range) across the run
engine_enforced_rules: all individual weights captured from the balance; manual entry flagged and verified
tier rules evaluated exactly (e.g. no more than k outside the tier-1 deviation and none outside tier-2) using the computed mean
balance must be calibrated and suitable (minimum weight) for the tablet mass
a failed evaluation places output since the last good check on hold
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110(a)(1); Ph. Eur. 2.9.5 uniformity of mass (tiered deviations relative to average mass); USP <905>

name: Tablet physical IPC: breaking force, thickness, diameter
purpose: Capture multi-parameter measurements per tablet from an automatic tablet tester or manual gauges and evaluate them.
config_options: parameters per tablet (weight, thickness, diameter/length, breaking force) and units (N or kp with conversion)
n tablets per check and per side
limits per parameter (mean and individual)
tester integration (one record per tablet with all parameters)
engine_enforced_rules: multi-parameter readings stay linked per tablet (no re-sorting that breaks the link)
unit conversions only via the UoM service (e.g. kp to N)
tester ID and calibration status stored; manual gauge values need verification
failing results create exceptions and hold output since last good check
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110(a); USP <1217> (tablet breaking force) as method reference

name: Friability test
purpose: Perform the friability test on a tablet sample and compute percentage weight loss, with the compendial repeat logic.
config_options: sample size rule by unit mass
number of drum revolutions
limit for mean weight loss
repeat rule when the first result is doubtful
observation of broken/cracked tablets as fail criterion
engine_enforced_rules: initial and final masses captured from the balance; % loss computed by the engine
when the configured repeat rule is triggered, all runs are kept and the mean is computed from all of them (no discarding of the first run)
presence of cracked/broken tablets is a mandatory question, not optional
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110(a); USP <1216> / Ph. Eur. 2.9.7 tablet friability (harmonised)

name: Disintegration test (in-process)
purpose: Run and record the in-process disintegration test for tablets (uncoated, film-coated, enteric with acid stage, orodispersible/effervescent variants).
config_options: apparatus and medium, temperature
number of units and time limit per dosage-form type
enteric variant: acid stage duration and requirement, then buffer stage
retest rule per compendium
engine_enforced_rules: bath temperature and instrument status checked before start
per-unit results recorded; the compendial retest rule is applied exactly and all results retained
time is measured by the engine or instrument, not typed

name: Bilayer / multilayer compression checks
purpose: Control multilayer tablets where each layer has its own blend, fill and weight, plus layer-sequence and interface integrity checks.
config_options: layers, blends per layer and layer order
first-layer tamping force and final compression force
layer weight checks (e.g. first-layer-only samples by press sampling mode) and total weight checks
layer-specific IPC frequencies
layer separation/delamination check
engine_enforced_rules: each layer's feed is bound to the correct blend container (scan); swapping blends between hoppers is blocked
layer weights and total weight are evaluated separately against their own limits
layer-only samples are identified as such and never mixed with full-tablet statistics

name: Press automatic weight control and reject system verification
purpose: Record the press's force-based automatic weight control settings, reject counts and reject-gate challenge results; import press event data.
config_options: force-weight control mode and limits (individual reject limits, mean control limits)
start-up reject quantity
reject-gate challenge frequency and method
press data to import (force trends, rejects, stops, speed)
engine_enforced_rules: control limits downloaded from approved values and read back
reject counts imported into reconciliation; rejected tablets cannot be returned to the good stream
reject-gate challenge failures hold output since the last good challenge

name: Metal detection and deduster challenge
purpose: Pass tablets through deduster and metal detector and verify detection capability with certified test pieces at defined times.
config_options: test piece types and sizes (ferrous, non-ferrous, stainless)
challenge timing (start, periodic, after stop, end)
reject handling and inspection of rejected tablets
engine_enforced_rules: test piece IDs are scanned and must be within certification
a failed challenge holds tablets processed since the last passing challenge and raises an exception
metal detector reject counts feed reconciliation

name: Coating suspension/solution preparation and hold
purpose: Prepare the film/sugar/functional coating dispersion and control its solids content, mixing and hold time.
config_options: coating system material(s) and solvent (aqueous vs organic with solvent safety checks)
target solids % and quantity (theoretical plus spray loss allowance)
mixing time and speed, de-aeration, sieving
maximum hold time and required continuous stirring
engine_enforced_rules: quantities computed and verified as for any formula calculation
hold time from preparation end to end of use enforced; expired dispersion cannot be used without QA disposition
continuous stirring confirmation (from equipment or periodic check) where configured

name: Coating process and weight gain
purpose: Run pan (or fluid-bed) coating, capture process parameters and determine coating weight gain to the endpoint; for functional coats, link to functional IPC (e.g. acid resistance).
config_options: pan load range (kg of cores) and pan speed
inlet/exhaust/product temperature, airflow, spray rate, atomising and pattern air pressures
weight gain determination: sample of n cores tared before coating vs coated weight, or total batch mass; target and limits
endpoint: theoretical dispersion sprayed, weight gain reached, or both
functional coat IPC reference (e.g. acid stage disintegration/dissolution) and polishing/curing step
engine_enforced_rules: weight gain computed by the engine from recorded core and coated masses at full precision
endpoint cannot be declared before the minimum weight gain or dispersion quantity is reached; exceeding maxima raises exceptions
parameters from the coater are imported with timestamps; manual readings flagged

name: Imprinting / laser marking verification
purpose: Verify tablet imprint or laser marking content and legibility during printing.
config_options: marking content from the approved product specification
check frequency and sample size
defect categories (smudged, missing, misregistered)
vision system integration
engine_enforced_rules: marking content is derived from product master data, not typed at the line
defect counts roll into reconciliation and AQL where configured
failed checks hold output since last good check

name: Blister packaging set-up and sealing control
purpose: Set up a thermoform or cold-form blister line for a pack format and control forming/sealing parameters and foil/film identity.
config_options: pack format (cavities per blister, blisters per carton) and change-part set ID
forming/lidding materials (PVC, PVC/PVDC, Alu-Alu cold form, lidding foil with print) with item codes
forming temperature, sealing temperature, pressure, dwell/speed ranges
feeder and empty-pocket detection settings
sample blisters for appearance and print check
engine_enforced_rules: change parts and materials are scanned and must match the pack format of the MBR; printed lidding follows label-issuance rules
sealing parameters downloaded/read back or captured; excursions outside validated ranges create exceptions and hold affected output
empty/broken-pocket rejects are counted into reconciliation

name: Blister/strip leak test
purpose: Periodic seal-integrity test of blisters/strips (e.g. dye ingress under vacuum or vacuum decay) as an in-process control.
config_options: method (dye ingress, vacuum decay) and instrument class
vacuum level, hold time and sample size (blisters/strips, per track)
frequency (start, periodic, after stops, after reel change, end)
pass/fail per cavity and action on failure
engine_enforced_rules: test parameters actually applied (vacuum, time) are captured from the tester or verified by a second person
any leaking cavity fails the check, holds output since the last passing check and raises an exception
missed scheduled tests are exceptions at review
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR 211.110, 211.130, 211.94 (container closure protection); USP <1207> principles as method guidance

name: Bottle packaging: count, desiccant, closure torque and induction seal
purpose: Control bottle filling of tablets: count verification, desiccant/filler insertion, cap application torque and induction seal integrity.
config_options: count per bottle and counter type (electronic/slat)
desiccant/cotton insertion and verification method
cap torque target and limits (application and removal)
induction seal check method and frequency
reject verification of the counter and cap/seal detectors
engine_enforced_rules: count verification checks are scheduled; failures hold output since last good check
torque readings captured from the torque tester with its calibration status
missing desiccant/seal detections are rejected and counted; detector challenge failures stop the step

name: Tablet visual defect inspection (AQL/sorting)
purpose: Inspect compressed or coated tablets for visual defects (chipping, capping, sticking, colour/coating defects, foreign tablets) by AQL sampling or 100% sorting.
config_options: defect catalogue and classes (critical/major/minor)
AQL sampling plan or 100% sorting mode (manual/automated)
acceptance numbers per class
action on failure (re-inspection only via approved procedure)
engine_enforced_rules: defect counts by class recorded per sample; acceptance evaluated by the engine
foreign tablet findings are critical and always raise an exception (possible mix-up)
rejected tablets feed reconciliation
